instruction: Query the OQMD database for the first NaCl entry (element_set=Na,Cl AND ntypes=2), extract name/composition/spacegroup/volume/delta_e/stability, and save to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_5.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
